nodes.value:
Select this macro and leave it stopped. The Event: Bossbar component can start the selected macro by itself when a matching bossbar appears.

In a creative test world with cheats, run:
/bossbar add litemacro:test {"text":"Litemacro Test"}
/bossbar set litemacro:test players @s

Expected local message:
Bossbar detected: Litemacro Test (100%).

Remove it afterward with:
/bossbar remove litemacro:test

You can also click Run first; then the event waits for the bossbar.
